title: Day 15: Flood Zones, Insurance & What Buyers Must Verify
excerpt: Flood-zone searches rise after every heavy rain cycle.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “flood zone homes Austin”, “Austin flood insurance cost”, and “is this house in a flood plain” want a local, practical answer.

Flood-zone searches rise after every heavy rain cycle.

Many desirable areas sit in or near FEMA-designated zones or have localized drainage issues.

Insurance costs and lender requirements can change the monthly payment significantly.

Always pull the current flood map and elevation certificate when available. Seller disclosures and recent claims history matter.

Some buyers walk away solely on insurance quotes; others budget for it as a permanent carrying cost.

Sellers in or near flood zones should have current documentation ready—transparency shortens the due-diligence period.
